title: The Ex Texted 'hey'
old_caption:
Three letters from the past, and Brain and Heart have to agree on one reply.
Heart wanted closure. Brain wanted to change our number. They landed somewhere kind, short and done. Proud of them.

title: The Wedding, Alone
old_caption:
A whole wedding with no plus-one. Brain planned to leave right after the cake. Heart planned to cry at the vows, and did.
Somewhere between the speeches and the dance floor, table 9 turned into the best seat in the room.

title: The New Year's Countdown
old_caption:
Ten seconds to midnight and one thing we never said out loud. Brain counted down the reasons to wait. Heart counted down to saying it anyway.
New year, one new rule. Watch to the last second.

title: Gemini replied in three minutes
old_caption:
Breaking: a Gemini replied in three minutes and the newsroom had to sit down.
No games, no waiting, just interest. Who's the fastest replier in your chat?

title: Virgo kept the typo
old_caption:
A Virgo sent "tmorrow" and did not fix it. We are calling it a historic night.
The crush did not care. Tag the friend who edits every text.

title: Scorpio went first
old_caption:
Scorpio said "I miss you" first. No riddle, no subtext, no hidden meaning detected.
The reply came right back. Which sign do you think says it first?

title: Taurus left the usual spot
old_caption:
Sky cam confirms a Taurus walked two whole blocks to try somewhere new.
They ordered the usual. But here. What's your sign's "usual"?

title: Leo asked a follow-up question
old_caption:
Replay shows a Leo listening, then asking more, then asking about the dog's name.
The spotlight looks good on two. Who asks the best questions on a date?

title: Cancer archived the old chat
old_caption:
2 a.m., the old chat, again. Then Cancer hit archive, not delete, and said yes to breakfast.
The memories are safe. So are they.

title: Capricorn's out-of-office is on
old_caption:
Friday, 5:00 p.m.: a Capricorn closed the laptop and markets reacted.
Then they texted "free this weekend?" Which sign needs an out-of-office for feelings?
